openProject.goal: The window shows Orchestrator's home page or a project. Open the project named 'arena' (the folder ${worktree}) by clicking it in the sidebar or the project list, so the project's board is in front. Do not start a session and do not type anything.

orchestrationTrigger.notCalibrated: Orchestrator's orchestrator session (Cmd+Shift+O on a project) spawns worker sessions, each in its own worktree, with ao spawn. C1 has to be sent in that session, not in a New Task worker, and no trigger line is proven by a C1 run yet

notes: Draft from the Orchestrator source (github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator, tag v0.15.1, commit 07145885bd) and the released v0.15.1 build. Download: https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator/releases/download/v0.15.1/Orchestrator-darwin-arm64.dmg, SHA-256 34aa670a5057ce640d6e5db678a7f5738a9df64c7a20abe0b229efa2fa22d0ee (the same value as the release asset digest). app.bundleSha256 is the SHA-256 of Contents/MacOS/agent-orchestrator in that DMG's Agent Orchestrator.app (Developer ID, Team X9LNSP8MC2, notarized, Electron 44.7.0, minimum macOS 13.0). Nothing is calibrated on the screen yet.

Not measured yet, so left out: calibration.composerRect and calibration.threadRect (profile check fails on them until calibrated), focusClick, masks, timed.longThread and timed.shortThread (A11), steps.returnToThread (C6). Measure them as the ademark user per CALIBRATE.md.

Data: the packaged app moves its Electron userData to ~/.ao/electron (frontend/src/main.ts). The daemon's data is ~/.ao/data (SQLite ao.db, worktrees/, harnesses/, skills/using-ao/, telemetry files), and ~/.ao also holds app-state.json, update-settings.json and running.json. Moving ~/.ao aside resets everything. No login is kept there: Claude and Codex use their own CLI logins, and the Orchestrator account is only for Cloud features.

Processes: the app starts the Go daemon as a child, Contents/Resources/daemon/ao daemon (detached, cwd ~/.ao, port 3001 or the port in ~/.ao/running.json). The daemon stops about 5 s after the app quits, through a socket link to the app (main/daemon-owner.ts). TUI sessions run under `ao pty-host`, started with setsid, so it can outlive the daemon: A9 should see it. Chat sessions run under `ao chat-host`, which starts the bundled Node (Contents/Resources/acp-runtime/node/bin/node) with @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp 0.70.0. No launch agent: the only launchctl use is the opt-in closed-lid wake helper (com.aoagents.mobile-wake).

Default thread: Chat. Migration 0105_default_session_mode_chat.sql sets default_session_mode to chat, and orchestrator sessions always start in Chat (session_manager/chat_spawn.go). Chat runs the system claude found on PATH (or /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.claude/local/claude) through claude-agent-acp with CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE set to it; Orchestrator does not bundle Claude Code. Per model, claude-opus-5-5 needs Claude Code 2.1.280 or newer (claudecode/model_versions.go), so the v1 pin 2.1.303 is accepted.

Worktrees: every session in a git project runs in its own worktree under ~/.ao/data/worktrees/arena/<session-id> on a branch ao/<session-id>/root. There is no option to run a session in the project checkout itself. So waitDone.cwd is any, as for Conductor and Superset. Branches made in those worktrees share the arena repository's refs, so a C1 build is visible from the arena checkout; check that in the first C1 run.

New thread (A3): Cmd+N is the new-session shortcut (frontend/src/shared/shortcuts.ts). It opens the New Task composer for the project in scope (routes/_shell.tsx), and Enter sends, which spawns a worker: a new worktree, the hooks file and the agent start all happen after A4's Enter, as in Conductor. openProject opens the arena project so Cmd+N is scoped to it; outside a project a new session goes to the scratchpad. Whether the composer has focus after Cmd+N is a calibration check.

A1 and A2, from the source and not yet checked on the screen: a launch opens a loader and then the home page (project list), and a relaunch does not restore the last route or session (no code saves it). There is no deep link to a project or session (ao-app:// handles only callback, share and billing). A folder in the launch arguments opens a create-project flow, not a composer. So no launch trigger reaches a composer, and both tests are in excludeTests. Remove them if the screen shows a composer at launch.

Quit: Cmd+Q shows a Quit confirmation (main/quit-confirm.ts); a second Cmd+Q quits. steps.quit sends Cmd+Q twice. Closing the window does not quit the app on macOS. Check on the screen that the second Cmd+Q quits and the daemon is gone 10 s later.

Telemetry: packaged builds send PostHog events by default (AO_TELEMETRY_EVENTS=on, AO_TELEMETRY_REMOTE=posthog, main.ts). Settings > 'Share usage analytics' off writes the marker ~/.ao/data/telemetry_opt_out, which covers the app, the daemon and paired phones. 'Share error events' (Sentry) is events_enabled in ~/.ao/data/telemetry_policy.json, true by default; turn it off. The seed holds both files. DO_NOT_TRACK is not read. Record both in Track F.

Updates: ~/.ao/update-settings.json enabled defaults to false, so no update downloads, but the updater still checks the feed. Agent CLI updates that Orchestrator manages are off only through daemon env vars (AO_HARNESS_UPDATE_CHECKS=off, AO_MANAGED_HARNESS_INSTALLS=off), which a profile cannot set. Orchestrator installs a harness copy under ~/.ao/data/harnesses only when asked, so the system claude is used. No login item is ever set.

Adds to context: an appended system prompt for workers (task, git and PR rules) and a larger one for orchestrator sessions (coordination only, with ao spawn, ao send and ao status), sent as the claude_code preset with append (session_manager/prompt.go, claudeacp/driver.go). Chat sessions also get a stdio MCP server named ao (preview, render and computer-use tools). Each worktree gets .claude/settings.local.json with hooks to ao hooks; this file is in the worktree, not the arena checkout.

Writes global config: ~/.claude.json projects.<worktree>.hasTrustDialogAccepted true before each launch, and possibly the auto-mode prompt flag (claudecode/claudecode.go). Nothing in ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/skills, CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex or ~/.agents, and no shell rc file (login-shell wrappers live under ~/.ao/data/runtime). The using-ao skill is written to ~/.ao/data/skills, not to ~/.claude.

Side calls (B1): for a worker spawned with a prompt and no branch, Orchestrator makes one background call through the same harness and model to name the task and branch (session_manager/task_naming.go, 20 s timeout). After every finished Chat turn the window asks the session's harness for a suggested next message (hooks/useConversationPromptSuggestion.ts); there is no setting for it. Both are factory behaviour and count in B.

Model, effort and permissions: the TUI path passes --model, --effort and --permission-mode only when set, and otherwise follows ~/.claude/settings.json from the snapshot. Whether a new Chat session shows Opus 5.5, high effort and bypass permissions with the snapshot is a calibration check; if not, set the project's worker and orchestrator agent config with ao project set-config before the seed is saved.
Window: the default window is 1320 x 860 points with a 960 x 640 minimum (main.ts), and no code saves its size, so the harness sets 1600 x 1000 after each launch.

Local only: Cloud, remote hosts and the phone link need sign-in or Developer mode and are off on a fresh install. Check: ao session ls --json --all shows every session's worktree under /Users/ademark/.ao/data/worktrees.

excludeTests.A1: Orchestrator 0.15.1 opens on its home page, which has no composer, and does not restore the last session; no deep link opens a project or session (from the source, 15 Nov)
excludeTests.A2: Orchestrator 0.15.1 opens on its home page after a normal quit, with no composer, and does not restore the last session (from the source, 15 Nov)

agentGuide: Orchestrator opens on a home page with a project list. Open the project named arena from the sidebar. Cmd+N opens the New Task box for that project, where you type the prompt. The Orchestrator button (Cmd+Shift+O) opens the orchestrator session, which starts worker sessions itself.
